facts.fact: The 2024 final account (Conta Geral do Estado, unaudited) shows the Ministério da Economia Digital spent CVE 489,920,474 of a reprogrammed CVE 1,483,485,681 (33.0%), with investment at zero of CVE 553,090,000; the ministry's own line, not a fund's.
The initial 2024 budget for the Ministério da Economia Digital was CVE 1,390,965,632 (Mapa III).

The 2024 account (Mapa VII) shows the Cabo Verde Plataforma Digital e da Inovação programme spent CVE 834,053,385 of CVE 1,932,225,900 (43.2%), of which CVE 368,439,563 from the treasury; the programme's own line.
facts.system: Cabo Verde Plataforma Digital e da Inovação programme, 2024

facts.fact: The 2024 account (Mapa VII) shows the Sistema de Informação para o Desenvolvimento Sustentável programme spent CVE 486,453,051 of CVE 4,974,474,263 (9.8%), of which CVE 243,405,114 from the treasury; scope as a digital line is partial.
facts.system: Sistema de Informação para o Desenvolvimento Sustentável programme, 2024

note: The 2024 account is unaudited per the document.
